findings.text: Re-review found one remaining lifecycle defect introduced by the denial repair: GamePanel refresh/send and SocialPanel refresh call deny() immediately on 401/403/404 before checking their captured generation/lifecycle. If the component unmounts or session changes while that request is pending, its late denial still runs; GamePanel deny() calls global invalidatePrivateState(), deleting the new session’s drafts/intents. Room command already checks epoch before denial, which is the correct pattern. Guard ownership before processing denial (still drain every body), and add old-session/unmounted GET or POST → new-session draft → old403 regression. Current prior regression only covers late200 after a current denial, so misses the reverse ordering.

Discovery race follow-up: redirect evaluation runs before the monotonic setRoom guard, and a successful join does not invalidate an older in-flight preview. Concrete ordering: preview GET snapshots a temporarily full outsider view and stalls; racer leaves; Alice joins successfully (canonical200); send clears pending and refresh coalesces behind that old GET; old no-role/full snapshot returns after command finishes and triggers seatLost despite Alice now being a member. Retire pre-command reads after a successful membership mutation or gate redirects on a fresh post-resolution read/version. Current winner test returns a current member projection on refresh, so does not cover this stale-preview ordering.
